gaps.title: Species rules are graded only by historical and public evidence, none by an independent outcome test beyond river electrofishing surrogates
gaps.whyItMatters: Every response band, spawn window and night-movement claim is Level 3 (Sector-derived) and NOT_VALIDATED; nothing can be promoted without prospective comparison.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a bowfisher can rely on a species 'favorable / limiting' reading when choosing where and when to look.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when every species rule the Brain would show has an evidence grade from independent historical or public data (accepted, rejected, keep-in-calibration or ABSTAIN) with pre-declared tests, or when no public dataset remains that bears on it.
gaps.expectedOutput: A scored, pre-declared evaluation per rule against historical electrofishing, ichthyoplankton, agency and literature evidence, with an accept / reject / keep-in-calibration / ABSTAIN recommendation.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: OPTIONAL: any existing or owner-supplied observations may be added as evidence; they are never required.

gaps.title: All assessed species are at research maturity RESEARCH (none independently reviewed)
gaps.whyItMatters: REVIEWED and VALIDATED are refused by the runtime until a separate promotion decision; the score gate 'speciesValidation' caps the Fish score until at least one species is VALIDATED.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: How much weight a species' knowledge summary deserves.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when each reviewed species has a recorded independent review or the review needs a human the lane does not have.
gaps.expectedOutput: Reviewer sign-offs recorded in the review ledger; a promotion proposal for Michael.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Approval or decision (not field data): Independent reviewer; promotion approval by Michael.

gaps.title: Per-lake Biological State is an internal pilot; Depth and Vegetation inputs are unpublished
gaps.whyItMatters: Without published upstream states the dependent features are UNKNOWN fleet-wide; the product question 'what is this fish doing on this lake now?' cannot be answered.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Where on a lake and under which conditions to look for a given species tonight.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the upstream Brains publish the needed states or the pilot's graduation needs a decision by Michael.
gaps.expectedOutput: A graduation decision for the Biological State component and, if approved, its input declarations (brain.json consumes) with recorder instrumentation.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Approval or decision (not field data): Michael's decision to graduate the pilot into an orchestrated component.
